name: Rain
source:
The protagonist. A drifter and a burnout. Expelled from the University of Birmingham, a hacker not by trade but by calling. Loves rock music, addicted to substances, owns nothing but a red Les Paul electric guitar. Has started noticing symptoms of a condition known as 'span'. Rain isn't searching for the truth — the truth finds him.

[From [url=https://fatumblack.itch.io/borderofrain]itch.io[/url]]
